mapper.sql: a.id, a.after_sale_no, a.type, a.reason_code, a.quantity, a.description, a.evidence_url, a.status, a.closed_at, a.created_at, a.updated_at, a.consumer_id, u.display_name AS consumerName, o.order_no AS orderNo, a.order_item_id, oi.product_name AS productName, oi.spec AS spec, oi.unit_price AS unitPrice, oi.quantity AS itemQuantity, oi.after_sale_deadline AS afterSaleDeadline
FROM after_sale a JOIN order_item oi ON oi.id = a.order_item_id JOIN mock_order o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = a.consumer_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO after_sale (after_sale_no, order_item_id, consumer_id, type, reason_code, quantity, description, evidence_url, status) VALUES (#{afterSaleNo}, #{orderItemId}, #{consumerId}, #{type}, #{reasonCode}, #{quantity}, #{description}, #{evidenceUrl}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT id, after_sale_no, order_item_id, consumer_id, type, reason_code, quantity, description, evidence_url, status, closed_at, created_at, updated_at FROM after_sale WHERE id = #{id}
